summary: Frontend-only verification of the new AI chat 'Continue to Blind Request' feature. All three scenarios passed end-to-end: (1) After sending 'I need Lipitor 20mg tablets, 30 count', AI replied with the proactive closing message and the chat-continue-banner + large chat-continue-btn rendered below the chat window; Intake Progress shows Name=Lipitor, Dose=20mg, Form=tablet. (2) Clicking chat-continue-btn while anonymous navigated to /auth and localStorage.mf_pendingMed was set to {name:'Lipitor',dose:'20mg',form:'tablet'}. (3) After demo patient login the /patient New Request form was pre-filled (req-name=Lipitor, req-dose=20mg, req-form=tablet).
critical_code_review_comments: AIChat SESSION_ID is generated once at module load — all anonymous users in the same browser session share the ID (fine for demo, but note conversations don't reset on page reload).
The right-side 'continue-request-btn' becomes enabled as soon as identified.name exists (even before ready=true). Consider gating on ready to keep it consistent with the new large button.
'ready' state in AIChat is local; if parent Landing already tracks ready via onIdentified, duplicate state could drift. Currently harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New AIChat Continue button flow verified working. Backend AI (Claude Sonnet 4.6) returns ready=true and proactive closing message for fully specified meds. mf_pendingMed persistence + PatientDashboard prefill confirmed.
